parent: Own-vote gated 40stock/20gold/40bond core, 20-session allocation reviews and daily safety; no routine expiry or forced liquidation
branches: Same actual prior-close checkpoint, inherited orders honored; hold with daily safety versus one requested 10pp stock-to-selected-fund rotation (35% single-stock cap), or 10pp stock reduction to cash. If no stock donors, use cash toward selected stock up to 40% stock budget. Ordinary constraints may prevent or partially fill an action; no invented funding. Staged variant retries the initial frozen target using actual settled cash until candidate reaches its 3pp/25% band; daily safety has priority, failed candidate cancels intent, no forced end exit. Healthy targets can rebalance during funding repair
selection_history: Exploratory adaptive diagnostic, not preregistered: staged repair added after first one-shot run identified possible unfilled orders. No threshold chosen by highest ROI; 20/60 horizons and all frozen cohorts retained
risk: Own21/63/252positivevotes>=2/3; past covariance10% uniform cash scaling; urgent exit on vote failure or current risk breach
valuation: NAV mark including unsettled receipts at signal+H+1; no terminal sale or fabricated exit fee. This is not liquidated cash return, not concatenatable strategy performance. Future order queues retained
ranking_test: Choose highest existing 60-session trend score among currently eligible stocks; compare its actual marked account increment with equal-probability eligible stock action mean, hold=zero, cash action, and hindsight best. No hindsight winner used for trading
validation: Independent FIFO/cash/dividend audit and checkpoint parent ancestry, exact continuous-versus-resumed curves/trades/final state, frozen input/source checks, rerun all24previousmainaccounts unchanged
scope: Diagnostic, not a deployed investment strategy or unseen out-of-sample evidence. Overlapping cohorts and reviewed history; no ETF approximation; OTC publication/payment/product-contract and survivor caveats unchanged
